whatToWatch.text: 3-1 and riding a win streak into a home date with the Niners — Vegas has Seattle as a 3-point favorite, but a 45.5 total says nobody's expecting a shootout. This one's a knife fight.

Defense is the calling card: 18.25 points allowed per game and 2.75 sacks a night. San Francisco's been stingy too (16 points against per game), but they're only getting home 1.5 sacks a game — if Seattle's front wins again, that's the edge.

Availability bears watching on both sides: the Seahawks have one player out and four questionable, with Leonard Williams, Julian Neal and George Holani on the report. The 49ers are down two, including Mike Evans and Marques Sigle.

newsBlurb.text: Divisional football returns to Lumen Field when San Francisco visits for a Week 5 Sunday showdown. The 49ers get the full Seattle treatment — crowd noise, a hostile October afternoon, and a rivalry that rarely needs extra motivation. Kickoff details, TV, radio and streaming info are all set for October 11.
